headline: Cash and gold missing after elderly woman found murdered in Jatrabari flat
summary: A 68-year-old woman was killed in her home in Dhaka's Jatrabari area; police suspect a robbery gone wrong.
details: Shahida Begum, 68, was found dead in her flat in Rasulpur, under the Donia area of Jatrabari, around 10:30pm on Saturday.
The victim's daughter-in-law, Sharmin Akter, discovered the body after returning home from work to find the flat ransacked.
Police found a sharp weapon injury on the left side of Shahida's neck. Her body has been sent to Dhaka Medical College morgue for an autopsy.
Relatives informed police that a gold chain, a pair of gold earrings, and approximately Tk 5,000 in cash were missing from the residence.
Investigators suspect the perpetrators entered the flat to steal valuables and attacked Shahida after she noticed them.
Police are currently collecting CCTV footage from the surrounding area to identify the suspects and are investigating other possible motives.
caption:
A 68-year-old woman was found murdered in her Jatrabari flat with cash and gold missing.

Shahida Begum, 68, was found dead in her flat in Rasulpur, under the Donia area of Jatrabari, around 10:30pm on Saturday.

The victim's daughter-in-law, Sharmin Akter, discovered the body after returning home from work to find the flat ransacked.

Police found a sharp weapon injury on the left side of Shahida's neck. Her body has been sent to Dhaka Medical College morgue for an autopsy.

Relatives informed police that a gold chain, a pair of gold earrings, and approximately Tk 5,000 in cash were missing from the residence.

Investigators suspect the perpetrators entered the flat to steal valuables and attacked Shahida after she noticed them.

Police are currently collecting CCTV footage from the surrounding area to identify the suspects and are investigating other possible motives.

headline: Acting headmaster arrested for letting Class 10 student mark SSC scripts
summary: The acting headmaster of a school in Cumilla's Debidwar was arrested after a viral video showed him letting a student evaluate General Science answer scripts.
details: Police have arrested Md Bacchu Mia, the acting headmaster of Abdullahpur Haji Amir Ali High School in Cumilla's Debidwar, for allegedly allowing a Class 10 student to mark SSC answer scripts.
The student, Mehedi, has also been arrested on charges of marking the official examination papers.
The incident came to light after a video went viral on social media, showing Bacchu Mia—an assigned examiner for SSC General Science scripts—letting the student mark them instead.
Following the circulation of the video, the education ministry ordered an immediate investigation into the matter.
Based on the investigation, a case was filed against both the headmaster and the student under Sections 10, 12, and 13 of the Public Examinations (Offences) Act, 1980.
Police arrested the duo in a raid last night and produced them before a court after completing legal formalities.
caption:
A Class 10 student was marking SSC answer scripts under the orders of his headmaster. Now, both are behind bars.

Police have arrested Md Bacchu Mia, the acting headmaster of Abdullahpur Haji Amir Ali High School in Cumilla's Debidwar, for allegedly allowing a Class 10 student to mark SSC answer scripts.

The student, Mehedi, has also been arrested on charges of marking the official examination papers.

The incident came to light after a video went viral on social media, showing Bacchu Mia—an assigned examiner for SSC General Science scripts—letting the student mark them instead.

Following the circulation of the video, the education ministry ordered an immediate investigation into the matter.

Based on the investigation, a case was filed against both the headmaster and the student under Sections 10, 12, and 13 of the Public Examinations (Offences) Act, 1980.

Police arrested the duo in a raid last night and produced them before a court after completing legal formalities.
